Triage 6448267069, verbatim: "**p2:** the nav-item inspector cannot author `visible`, `viewName`, `recordId` / `recordMode`, `filters`, `badge` / `badgeVariant` or the order, although all of them are live at runtime. Add inspector controls for the keys the spec already declares. ⛔ No new key. From the studio-qa-2026-10-27 batch. Re-check the landing site on current `main`." No maintainer ruling.

### PM mechanism assumptions (measure; disproof welcome)

On `origin/main` `5ec398dc`:
- `StudioNavItemInspector` (`StudioDesignSurface.tsx` ≈L2613–2986) authors type, label, object/target and icon. `visible` is shown as read-only text (`data-testid="nav-visible-when"`, ≈L2917). There is no control for `viewName`, `recordId`/`recordMode`, `filters`, `badge`/`badgeVariant`, `requires*` or order.
- The card says the Setup `AppNavInspector` (`metadata-admin/inspectors/AppNavInspector.tsx`) "has them". A grep finds `viewName` (≈L496), `recordId` (≈L507) and reorder buttons (≈L429) there, but no `badge`, `requires*` or `visible` control. Treat "the Setup inspector has them" as partly false. The binding scope is the spec: offer exactly the keys `NavigationItemSchema` declares per member (read `@objectstack/spec` and `nav-target.ts` `TYPED_TARGET_FIELDS`), and nothing the member does not take.
- `visible` is a predicate. Measure how Studio authors other predicates (the CEL-gated fields, `DataPillar.celGate`) and use the same control and validation. ⛔ No free-text field that saves a predicate the server would refuse without saying so.

### Scope

File surface: `StudioNavItemInspector` in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (≈L2613–2986) only; import controls from `metadata-admin/inspectors` where they already exist. If a shared control has to be extracted from `AppNavInspector.tsx`, make it a pure move with no behaviour change, and list it under deviations (that file is shared with the Setup pages). Studio namespace rows and tests. Tests: each declared key can be authored and is written in the canonical spelling; a key the member does not declare is not offered; `visible` round-trips; order moves an entry. Ablation per control. ⛔ No new spec key.

Serial: #26743 (seat 5, this round) edits `isNavTargetRow` / `usePackageNavTargets` (≈L2987–3060) just below your region; don't edit those two, call them.

### Tier

No path-derived mandate. `TIER_DEFAULT`, effort `high` (M). `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` expected.
